name: io.github.Whatsonyourmind/deckforge
description: Executive-ready PPTX and Google Slides decks from natural language or JSON IR. 32 slide types.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Anthropic API key - required only for the `generate` tool (natural-language deck generation). The other five tools (render, themes, slide_types, cost_estimate, pricing) need no key.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key - optional alternative LLM provider for the `generate` tool.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Google Gemini API key - optional alternative LLM provider for the `generate` tool.
